newsitem.title: UK: Pearson's Scardino has joining bonus.
newsitem.headline: Pearson's Scardino has joining bonus.

text.p: Pearson Plc chief executive Marjorie Scardino received a 130,000 stg bonus as soon as she joined the company in January this year, the company's 1996 accounts showed.
The "golden hello" was paid to compensate for the loss of benefits from her previous employer, the 50-percent Pearson owned Economist Group.
Scardino's base annual salary is 396,000 stg and the Texan will also be provided with housing at an initial annual cost to the company of 60,500 stg.
Under the company's annual bonus plan and its incentive share plan, Scardino will be conditionally awarded shares to the value of 300,000 stg this year and 200,000 stg in each of the next two years.
